text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). Liver enzymes show mild ALT elevation. Coagulation is altered (elevated INR). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or viral illness, and risk for coagulopathy. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
